title: River Client 0.3.1
summary: Signed Windows releases, native macOS builds and more reliable updates.
items: Added: Native macOS builds for Apple Silicon and Intel.
Added: Fox cape, free for everyone.
Changed: The Galaxy cape is now Galaxysdc's creator cape. Enter the code GALAXY in Cosmetics to keep wearing it.
Improved: The Windows app and installer are signed by Supro Nivelo s.r.o., so Windows no longer warns about an unknown publisher.
Improved: Saved accounts are stored encrypted.
Fixed: The Wardrobe now shows every cape in the game's order, instead of the first seven.
Fixed: Module settings only show the options that module actually uses, and the Spotify module draws its background, border and colours properly.
Fixed: The in-game browser now finds shaders and resource packs for the version you are playing, not only 1.21.11.
Fixed: Update checks rejecting a release when the server changed its minimum version.
Fixed: A failed update now rolls back instead of leaving the launcher half updated.
Fixed: Instance exports move between PCs, long profile names no longer hang an import, and interrupted mod updates recover.
